page.overview:
Who is Korin?

Korin was a Nordling warrior who was presumably Geralt of Rivia's father.

He was a wanderer, churl, troublemaker, and swashbuckler. While Korin was not present in his life, Geralt believed his father's genes were more dominant, evidenced by his own proficiency at "swashing a buckler".
